traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS are satisfied with concrete implementation and passing tests: - Core Functionality: `require-branch-annotation` is implemented to visit all significant branch node types (if, switch cases, loops, try/catch, catch clauses) and report missing @story/@req annotations, with autofixes where appropriate. This is verified by extensive RuleTester suites in `tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts`. - Quality Standards and Performance: The rule uses standard ESLint RuleModule structure with schema, messages, and fixers, and a dedicated performance test in `tests/perf/require-branch-annotation-large-file.test.ts` confirms it scales to large nested-branch files within a defined time budget. - Integration and Nested Handling: The helper utilities manage complex branch comment association, including switch-case and catch-clause specifics; tests cover nested if-structures and multiple branch types, demonstrating robust handling of complex control flow. - User Experience and Error Handling: Error messages clearly indicate which annotation type is missing and, for invalid configuration, list allowed branch types. Catch-related edge cases, blank-line spacing before switch cases, and inner-catch insertion behavior are all handled gracefully with dedicated tests. - Documentation & Preset Integration: The rule has its own documentation page with examples and configuration guidance, is referenced from the README, and is included in both recommended and strict plugin presets with tests verifying these configurations. Given the implementation, test coverage, performance test, and documentation, this story is fully implemented.
